title: PR #6490 moved structure-board rendering into a new generic render_object_structure admin endpoint and dropped the user_can_change_page check the old details() path applied, so any staff user can read the plugin structure of pages they may not view.

findings.explanation: The diff does not introduce any SQL query construction or database operations with user-controlled input. The changes involve permission checks using Django ORM method calls (has_add_plugins_permission, check_source) and primary key comparisons, which use Django's ORM parameterization.

The diff adds authorization checks to prevent unauthorized access to plugin copy operations. The changes introduce source-side permission verification (lines 545-548 and 581-584) to prevent users without placeholder access from exfiltrating content. These checks verify that the source placeholder is accessible to the requesting user before allowing the copy operation, addressing CWE-639 (IDOR). The deny_of_service mitigation (lines 788-804) prevents cyclic reparenting without authorization bypass.
